question: Which b-tagging algorithm was used, at what efficiency working point, and what rejection factor did it give against light-quark and gluon jets?
expect: MV1, 70% efficiency, rejection about 140 (about 5 against charm) (sec. 3)
rendered: MV1 algorithm, a multivariate discriminant making use of track impact parameters and reconstructed secondary vertices, was used at a 70% efficiency for tagging b-quark jets from top decays in t¯t events, giving a rejection factor of about 140 against light-quark and gluon jets, and about five against jets originating from charm quarks.
